notes.title: Version 5.0.14
notes.content:
Tweaked the order of availability of story quests in order to provide a better experience for new players. Story quests now needs to be completed in this order:

[olist]
[*] DJ
[*] Christmas
[*] Comic Book
[*] Paint Store
[*] Spy
[*] Police
[*] Horror Quests
[/olist]

If before the update you have made some progress on a certain quest but haven't completed the previous quest necessary to unlock it, then your progress on that quest will be halted until you completed the previous quest.

For example, if you have made some progress with the Comic Book quest, but haven't completed the Christmas quest, then after the update the Comic Book quest will be temporarily locked. After you complete the Christmas quest, you will be able to continue your progress on the Comic Book quest.

notes.title: Version 5.0.9
notes.content:
Small hotfix and some quality-of-life fixes

[list]
[*] Lori will now prioritize putting items that were placed previously in the empty shelf/vending machine if stock for that item exists on the storage racks
[*] Notification for carpet customer waiting to be served
[*] Improvements to notifications for obstacle spawning so that they always appear even if the player is currently in a UI screen
[*] Improvements to NPC behavior to help with customers and staffs getting stuck walking in place. Please let us know if this issue persists after updating to this version.
[/list]

Further fixes to common issues are still ongoing and will be released in a future update. New staffs for features that currently doesn't have one are also planned for a future update. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Version 2.1.5
notes.content:
The final DJ quest now requires you to have an empty inventory slot.

If you have finished the quest while your inventory was full and didn't get the reward, the item will be automatically granted to your inventory when you enter the game after this update. If your inventory is currently full, the game will wait until there's a space to give you the item. You can get in the game, empty a slot in your inventory, go back to the main menu, and enter the game again, and you should have the item.
